stateMachine: CREATE: when no release statement exists, package:mac builds, signs, notarizes, staples, seals the package set, and invokes the controller-owned exclusive writer exactly once as its final producer step.

REUSE: when the statement exists, package:mac must not rebuild, resign, renotarize, restaple, or invoke the writer; it securely reopens and validates the same immutable package set and statement against externally pinned HEAD and matrix identity, then returns zero only on exact agreement.

REJECT: any invalid statement, package/hash/identity mismatch, partial state, alternate path, link, writable artifact, wrong RC/matrix, or attempted replacement returns nonzero without repair, checkout movement, or new output.
requiredLifecycleProof: Run 1 with no review: package:mac creates once and returns 0; collection succeeds; verify:release returns nonzero because review is absent; aggregate is nonzero.

After a valid independent review is added, the unchanged reporter rerun enters REUSE; package and statement bytes/inodes/hashes remain unchanged; writer invocation count remains one; all child exits and aggregate are zero.
A third identical rerun is also zero and mutation-free, proving idempotent validation rather than a special one-off bypass.
requiredNegativeTests: Missing, replaced, writable, linked, or hash-mismatched package
Wrong RC, matrix digest/revision/path, architecture set, signing identity, or notarization/staple/spctl result
Writer invocation, rebuild, resign, renotarize, restaple, statement replacement, checkout selection, or artifact mutation during REUSE
Concurrent exclusive-create collision that does not resolve to the exact already-valid immutable package/statement identity
